5. Describe the event(s) that you believe was discriminatory. Include: What happened? Who was involved? When did it happen? Where did it happen?

Inland Psychiatric Medical Group maintains systemic failures in providing access to Protected Health Information (PHI). These practices result in the loss of medical records, misdirected correspondence, and the intentional obstruction of legal service and patient grievance processes. This filing is part of a formal administrative exhaustion process to document these administrative failures and the resulting harm to my right to access and the integrity of my medical data.
